# B03 — Give each piece of work a durable record

[START](../../guide/00-START.md). Depends: B02. Read [WORK CONTRACT](../../guide/03-WORK-CONTRACT.md), Records and Status sections.

Planned files: `server/work/contracts.ts`, `server/work/repository.ts`, next numbered SQL migration, `tests/work/repository.test.ts`. Read existing DB/migration/ID patterns first.

## Slices

- **s1:** Define Zod schemas and inferred TypeScript types for jobs, steps, attempts, artifacts, controls and snapshots. Use strict bounded inputs, discriminated states and explicit schema versions. Test invalid enums, missing fields, cyclic/cross-job dependencies and unbounded budgets.
- **s2:** Create migration and repository methods for acceptance, reads and conditional transitions. One request ID maps to one job. Persist job/steps/dependencies/outbox in one transaction. Test rollback injected between writes.
- **s3:** Add immutable artifact versions and versioned snapshot projection. Verify stored bytes/hash; artifact identity uses composite (artifact_id,version). Test update conflict, unknown reference and reopening the file database.

Do not call a model or perform network effects in this task. A transaction is short local work.

## Gate

Repeated acceptance returns the same job. Invalid plans produce no rows. A failed write produces no half-job. Older expectedVersion cannot overwrite newer state. Snapshot reconstructed after restart matches durable state.

Next: B04/s1. Publish the actual exported contracts and their hashes in checkpoint evidence so the next worker does not invent a second interface.
